name: docs-editor-fast-preview
title: Add instant HMR draft preview and background stable builds
description: Split the interactive 4173 VitePress Dev preview from the immutable 4175 production preview and make stable builds asynchronous and debounced.
creator: wg
notes: Deployed to kbdev at 8c25f90. Ports 4173/4174/4175 and all systemd services are active. Real save returned queued in 22ms; the 4173 browser saw the Markdown update 289ms after the API response timestamp. Stable release 23 completed 38.563s after save, including the 8s debounce and full build. Restore save returned in 20ms and release 24 restored the original document. The pre-existing docs/cli/index.md user draft and its marker were backed up, preserved byte-for-byte, and restored after acceptance.
